To help address the prolonged stretch of severe drought Missouri farmers and ranchers have been dealing with, USDA has now designated Miller, Perry, St. Clair, and Washington counties as primary natural disaster areas, with 23 more Missouri counties eligible as contiguous counties.

This designation makes farmers in these counties eligible to be considered for FSA emergency loans, much-needed help to cover production losses and keep operations running. Producers have 8 months to apply.

Contact your local FSA office, and find more info here: https://t.co/UGxR5R1DFl

Tomorrow, less than 24 hours after returning to Washington, the House Republican Conference is scheduled to meet to select who will lead us for the next two years. @SteveScalise and @Jim_Jordan are outstanding men who are more than up to the job.

We are less than a week removed from Tuesday’s elections, and need to understand how and why we lost the trust of the American people. We also need, as a Conference, to address how our rules have empowered members to vote against rules, bills, and even the Speaker. Failing to address these issues before choosing someone new to lead our Conference is doing a disservice to whoever we choose as Republican Leader.

We should delay our Leadership elections until we decide how to hold each other accountable and what our path forward should be. Our rules must never again permit a Leader to be taken hostage to the whims of an individual member. We can and must do better.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
